content.value_statement: Vague UI ideas often lack structure, style details, and design-system context. This skill turns them into Stitch-ready prompts with clear sections, UI terms, colors, and optional file output.
actual_capabilities: Expands vague UI requests into structured Stitch prompts.
Adds platform, theme, color, typography, and component guidance.
Uses DESIGN.md content when available to preserve design consistency.
Includes UI and UX keyword references for component and style vocabulary.
Can write enhanced prompts to next-prompt.md or a user-named file when requested.
limitations: Designed for Stitch UI generation, not general prompt engineering.
Does not validate whether generated UI is accessible or production ready.
External documentation guidance depends on the current Stitch prompting guide.
File output only happens when the user explicitly asks.

use_cases.title: Shape Rough Screen Ideas
use_cases.description: Turn a short UI idea into a structured prompt with sections, components, colors, and style direction.

use_cases.title: Keep Pages Consistent
use_cases.description: Add design-system context from DESIGN.md so new prompts match existing colors, typography, and component styles.

use_cases.title: Improve Failed Generations
use_cases.description: Rewrite a weak prompt into a clearer request that focuses on hierarchy, layout, and specific UI elements.

prompt_templates.title: Enhance a Simple UI Idea
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when starting from a short concept.
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance this Stitch prompt for a [web or mobile] screen: [paste idea]. Add structure, visual style, colors, and component terms.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Weak Result
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after Stitch generated an unclear or generic UI.
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this prompt so Stitch produces a stronger result: [paste prompt]. Focus on layout, hierarchy, visual style, and missing UI details.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Design System
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the project has DESIGN.md or brand guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance this Stitch prompt using the current project design system: [paste prompt]. Preserve brand colors, typography, and component style.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Multi-Screen Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when planning a connected product flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this product flow into Stitch-ready prompts: [describe flow]. Separate each screen, define shared design rules, and specify key components.

output: A clean, trustworthy login page with a centered form and subtle branding.
Includes platform, theme, background, accent colors, text colors, button style, and card treatment.
Defines header, login card, submit button, helper links, and footer sections.
A targeted edit that places search in the header before the user avatar.
Specifies a pill-shaped input, search icon, placeholder text, focus behavior, and responsive width.
Preserves existing layout and avoids unrelated changes.
A calm mobile-first home screen prompt with soft colors, clear hierarchy, and focused content areas.
Defines greeting, daily session card, progress summary, category chips, and bottom navigation.
Adds visual guidance for spacing, rounded corners, typography, and primary actions.

best_practices: Provide the target platform and page type before asking for enhancement.
Share DESIGN.md or brand colors when consistency matters.
Use targeted prompts for edits so the output changes only one area.
anti_patterns: Asking for a whole app without naming screens or user goals.
Mixing unrelated edits into one prompt.
Using vague mood words without layout, component, or color details.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It turns rough UI ideas into structured prompts designed for better Stitch generation results.

faq.question: Is it only for Stitch?
faq.answer: It is optimized for Stitch, but the structured prompt format can help other UI generation tools.

faq.question: Can it use DESIGN.md?
faq.answer: Yes. It can read DESIGN.md and include the design system in the enhanced prompt.

faq.question: Does it write files?
faq.answer: Yes, but only when requested. It can write next-prompt.md or a custom filename.

faq.question: Does it call external services?
faq.answer: It recommends consulting official Stitch documentation, but it contains no code that sends user data anywhere.

faq.question: Can it fix weak prompt results?
faq.answer: Yes. It can add missing structure, UI vocabulary, visual direction, and targeted edit guidance.
